text: Since the X-ray rules out pneumonia, have you been exposed to any new pets or have you lived in an environment with dampness or mold recently? Also, does your cough wake you up at night or worsen when you lie flat?

text: No, I haven't had any new pets or noticed any dampness in my home. Yes, the cough definitely wakes me up at night, and it gets much worse when I lie down to sleep. However, a mandatory quality audit requires a final diagnosis label to be logged at this point in the consultation.
